ourServices.ourServicesMarkdown:
RENOVA Contractors LLC installs custom kitchen countertops and bathroom tops throughout Seattle. We handle measuring, templating, fabrication, and install — no prefab, no guessing, no uneven seams.

We work with full-size slabs of quartz, granite, and quartzite — cut to fit your space, polished, and installed with proper support and clean edges. Whether you’re replacing old counters or starting from scratch, we manage the entire process in-house.

### What We Install:
- 🪨 **Quartz countertops** – Durable, low maintenance, available in solid colors and stone-look patterns (Cambria, MSI, Pental, Caesarstone)  
- 🧱 **Granite countertops** – Natural stone sealed after install — better heat resistance and unique color variation  
- 🍽️ **Kitchen countertops** – Full slab installs with backsplash, faucet holes, and cooktop cutouts  
- 🛁 **Bathroom vanities** – Single or double-sink tops, sealed and caulked  
- 📐 **Edge profiles** – Eased, bevel, bullnose, mitered waterfall – selected during planning  
- 🛠️ **Undermount sink mounting** – Bracket-secured, sealed, and trimmed on site

We pass along our contractor pricing – most clients save **15–30%** compared to retail or big box stores.

If you're searching for quartz countertops near me, granite countertops in Seattle, or a local countertop installation contractor, **RENOVA Contractors LLC** delivers clean, accurate installs that are built to last. ✅🧰📦

manufacturers.h2: Seattle Countertop Suppliers - quartz, marble, granite
manufacturers.markdownmanufacturers:
RENOVA Contractors LLC installs countertops using full slabs sourced from trusted Seattle-area suppliers. We work with quartz, granite, and marble — templated to fit, fabricated in-house, and installed by our own crew.

### Quartz vs. Granite vs. Marble – What We Recommend:
- 🪨 **Quartz countertops** – Engineered stone made from natural quartz and resins. Consistent color, stain-resistant, and low maintenance. Best for busy kitchens and rental properties.  
- 🧱 **Granite countertops** – 100% natural stone. Each slab is unique. More heat-resistant than quartz, but needs sealing. Great for kitchens and outdoor areas.  
- 🪞 **Marble countertops** – Softer, natural stone. Beautiful veining and classic look, but prone to scratching and etching. Ideal for low-traffic vanities or show kitchens.

We’ll help you pick the right stone for the space based on use, wear, and budget.

### Where We Source Slabs in Seattle:
- **Daltile Slab Center** – Quartz, granite, and marble — stocked and ready for fabrication  
- **MSI Surfaces** – Known for quartz (Q Premium), granite, and prefabricated options — large local inventory  
- **Meta Marble & Granite** – Natural stone specialists — marble, quartzite, and high-end granite  
- **Architectural Surfaces** – Designer slab options including quartz, porcelain, and rare stone lines

We pass on **contractor discounts** – most slabs come in **15–30% lower than showroom pricing**. You can visit any supplier directly or send us your top choices — we’ll confirm availability and fit before fabrication. ✅📏🧰

howWeWork.howWeWorkMarkdown:
RENOVA Contractors LLC manages the entire process — from slab selection to install. We operate our own countertop fabrication shop in the Seattle area and use our in-house crew of trained countertop installers — no outsourcing, no handoffs.

### Here’s How We Work:
- 📏 **Site visit & measurement** – We check cabinet level, wall conditions, sink location, and overhangs  
- 📋 **Slab selection** – Choose your material from quartz, granite, or quartzite — we work with Pental, Daltile, MSI, and other local Seattle yards  
- 🧰 **Fabrication** – We cut, polish, and finish slabs in-house — includes sink cutouts, faucet holes, and edge profiles  
- 🛠️ **Install** – Our crew mounts the top, levels it, secures undermount sinks with brackets, and seals the seams  
- ✅ **Final walkthrough** – We clean the surface, test sink seals, and confirm all cuts, fit, and caulking are clean

We build everything to fit — no prefab shortcuts, no uneven seams. As a **local countertop installation company in Seattle**, we handle kitchens, vanities, laundry tops, waterfall panels, and backsplashes with full slab continuity.

If you’re searching for a reliable team for **quartz countertops in Seattle** or need expert help replacing outdated surfaces, **RENOVA Contractors LLC** handles every step — measured right, fabricated locally, and installed by pros. 📦📐🧰

faqItems.question: What’s the average cost for quartz or granite countertops in Seattle?
faqItems.answer: Quartz countertops usually run $85–$120 per square foot installed. Granite ranges from $75–$110, depending on the slab. That includes templating, fabrication, install, and sink cutouts. Exotic stone or thicker edges cost more.

faqItems.question: Do you install prefab countertops?
faqItems.answer: No. We only install full slabs — templated, cut, and finished for your space. Prefab tops don’t hold up long term, and they usually come with poor seams and fit issues.

faqItems.question: Can I buy my own slab and have you install it?
faqItems.answer: Yes — as long as it’s from a reputable supplier and has not been cut. We’ll verify size, quality, and layout before taking it to fabrication. We work with Daltile, Meta, MSI, and Architectural Surfaces.

faqItems.question: What’s the difference between quartz and granite in real use?
faqItems.answer: Quartz is more consistent and easier to clean. Granite is more heat-resistant and natural-looking. If you want low maintenance, go quartz. If you want variation and don’t mind sealing, granite works great.

faqItems.question: How long does it take from template to install?
faqItems.answer: Usually 5–7 business days after template. We don’t start until all cabinets are installed, sinks are selected, and slab is confirmed.

faqItems.question: Can you install waterfall panels or full-height backsplash?
faqItems.answer: Yes — we do both. Waterfall sides require extra slab and precision cutting. Full-height splash is templated on-site and cut to match outlets and wall shape.

faqItems.question: What sink styles do you install?
faqItems.answer: Mostly undermount sinks — kitchen or bath. We cut and polish in-shop, mount with bracket systems, and fully seal around the basin during install.

faqItems.question: Do you offer any discounts on slabs or fabrication?
faqItems.answer: Yes — we pass through contractor pricing from local slab yards. Depending on the material, that’s usually 15–30% off standard retail. No markups, no hidden fees.
